scope: canonical admission of exact F-MR33 DIVDRA runtime binding source only

entries.basis: Binding calls the single canonical drainage process provider; no alternate SWAP kernel is introduced.
Binding contains no file, format, parsing, unit or path I/O.
Parameters, explicit hydraulic view, scalar transfer, publication target and diagnostics remain separate typed inputs/outputs.
No persistent per-column state is added.
Node-transfer and process diagnostics are call-local temporaries; no solver scratch is persisted per column.
Publication target is a generic allocatable real matrix and does not force an object-per-column storage layout.
Binding has no committed-state mutation and therefore does not weaken checkpoint/trial/commit rollback semantics.
Binding is stateless and deterministic for explicit inputs, permitting cheap reevaluation from the correct supplied state/view.
No day, month, year, midnight or fixed-duration assumption exists.
No coupling-window duration or calendar window is introduced.
Coupling machinery is untouched; explicit hydraulic-view input remains compatible with future transactional coupling.
No MODFLOW interface contract is changed or assumed.
Authoritative scalar transfer is passed through to the qualified process and the resulting row is copied exactly; binding does not renormalize or reconstruct mass.
No response-tangent API or solver factorization is modified.
Binding adds one process call only and introduces no repeated full-column coupling runs.
Stateless binding and generic matrix publication do not create one heavy solver instance per logical column.
No MODFLOW cell/tile fraction or 1:1 mapping assumption appears.
Deep-vadose transfer-zone composition remains outside this source and is not precluded.
No component transition or transfer-zone storage is introduced.
Binding depends on the common explicit process hydraulic-view contract, not a specific Richards implementation.
Existing qualified drainage physics is reused rather than duplicated.
Hydraulic information enters through process_hydraulic_view_t; HeadCalc internals and arrays are not exposed.
Binding adds no solver policy and does not alter physical configuration or provider equations.
Bounded-cost solver/fallback policy is untouched; binding adds no unbounded iteration.
Reference-mode availability is unchanged and reference tree remains untouched.
Binding returns explicit status, process status/evaluated flag, publication flag, active-node count and authoritative scalar diagnostics.
No storage exists when the binding is unused; publication allocation occurs only when invoked successfully.
Binding knows neither tile fractions nor groundwater transfer routing; those remain runtime/coupler composition concerns.
No implicit .swp, midnight, one-day, file-format or direct-MODFLOW dependency is introduced.
This F-CI33 artifact explicitly audits all 30 invariants for the canonical admission delta.
